content: सोत्क, सोत्कण्ठ {%a.%} .²1 Ardently longing, impatiently eager, anxious; as in सोत्कण्ठमालिङ्गनम्. .²2 Regretful. .²3 Bewailing, sorrowing. .{@-ण्ठम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 With ardent or eager longing, anxiously; प्रोड्डीयेव बलाकया सरभसं सोत्कण्ठमालिङ्गितः <ls>Mk. 5. 23</ls>. .²2 Regretfully, sorrowfully.
